events.summary: 20's & 30's Full Moon Hike at Mt. Wachusett

description.plain:
Thursday, April 30, 2026 | 7:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX0000015nPJ2AY/
Join us for an evening hike up Mt. Wachusett during an (almost) full moon, aka, the Flower Moon! We will hike 3-5 miles (depending on if we take a shorter route) with a total elevation gain of about 750 ft. Weather permitting, we plan to spend some time at the summit to enjoy the moon and stars and perhaps some snacks. The trails will include sections of moderate terrain and we will be moving at a moderate pace.Proper equipment will be required for this hike, including: hiking and weather appropriate clothing, water, a day pack, and a headlamp. No dogs please.

Monday, May 4, 2026
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX0000015e132AA/
Join us for an after work hike to Tetasset Ridge/Gods Acre on the west side of Worcester. We will hike ~3-4 miles with a total elevation gain of about 400 ft-- we'll stop for a view over the city and to see a historical marker. The trails will include sections of moderate terrain and we will be moving at a moderate pace.Proper equipment will be required for this hike, including: hiking and weather appropriate clothing, water, and a headlamp.You'll be asked to fill out a screening form upon registration for the hike.

events.summary: AMC150 Worcester Chapter TrailsFest: 20s & 30s East-West Trail Hike - Prospect Hill and Newton Hill

description.plain:
Saturday, June 6, 2026 | 8:30 AM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX0000016iFV2AY/
Join the Worcester Chapter 20s & 30s on a ~4 mile hike along a segment of the East-West Trail, which traverses the city of Worcester over 14 miles. This hike will take us through Institute Park, Salisbury Park, and Elm Park over a variety of terrain -- from the trails up to Newton Hill to walking through neighborhoods near Prospect Hill. One notable landmark on the hike is Bancroft Tower, a 125-year-old 56-foot-high (17 m) tower of granite and natural stone. We will plan on ending our hike at Bancroft Tower and spending some time there. Despite the short mileage, there is an expected elevation gain of around 630 ft throughout the hike centered around Prospect Hill and Newton Hill.Participants must bring:Minimum 1 liter of waterSnacks as necessaryLayers as the weather dictates, including outer shellHiking shoes or boots with good treadBackpack to carry gearConfirmed participants can expect an email a few days before the activity with weather, meeting location, and parking details.After this trip, please join us for the AMC150 Worcester Chapter TrailsFest 2026, taking place Saturday, June 6, 2026 at Institute Park in Worcester! TrailsFest, which has been held annually since 2018, coincides with National Trails Day and is co-hosted by a group of organizations including the Appalachian Mountain Club and Park Spirit.At this event, we celebrate trails in all their forms, including hiking trails, bike paths, waterways, and climbing routes. Here is what the day will look like:Morning through 12pm: Activities like this one throughout the area.12pm to 4:00pm: AMC150 Worcester Chapter TrailsFest celebration at Institute Park. Food, live music, speakers, friends, and fun!BYO non-alcoholic beverages and a chair.Bring yourself, your friends and family, and spread the word!In 2026, the Appalachian Mountain Club is celebrating 150 years of protecting, enjoying, and understanding the outdoors! At the heart of the celebration is the AMC 150th Outdoor Relay—a connected series of outdoor adventures traveling from Virginia to Maine with a commemorative AMC flag carried along the entire route.

events.summary: Worcester 20s & 30s 2nd Annual Hostel Takeover Weekend in the White Mountains

description.plain:
Friday, June 26, 2026 | 8:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX00000152yH2AQ/
Join the Worcester Chapter 20s & 30s for a weekend of outdoor fun in the White Mountains June 26-29 for the second annual Hostel Takeover! This year’s theme is…aliens! Expect the theme to crop up throughout the trip; participation in it is optional!The trip runs from the evening of Friday, June 26 through Monday, June 29. A variety of hiking and socializing opportunities will be offered each day as we explore several regions of the White Mountains. At least two hiking options, one moderate and one vigorous, will be provided each day (for rating definitions, go here). Specific offerings will be determined by leaders that weekend depending on participant ability and conditions. Hikes will be in the immediate area and possibly others farther afield. After the days’ hikes, we will all return to the Conway Hostel (CoHo), our basecamp for the weekend. The trip includes three nights’ lodging at CoHo, where you will find all the comforts you are looking for after a long hike– shared bunk rooms, private bathrooms, a shared kitchen with full access, and shared space for socializing. A group dinner will be included and served on Saturday and Sunday evening, and CoHo offers free coffee, tea, and granola bars for breakfasts. Friday night dinner will be an optional potluck. Breakfast (other than what the hostel offers) and lunches not included. Evening activities will be offered, possibilities including a movie screening, star gazing, fire pit, and games. The hostel is also a ~5 minute walk away from the Saco River where swimming is allowed.Cost is $170 for AMC members ($185 for non-members) per person for 3 nights at CoHo and 2 dinners. If the cost of this trip is an obstacle for you being able to attend, please reach out to Jake at jjscoggin@gmail.com, as we have limited subsidy options available. Refunds are not guaranteed and are dependent on someone taking your spot if this event reaches full capacity. Once you register for the trip here, one of the leaders will send a screening form to gather further information to ensure the trip will be safe and fun for all participants. Payment will be collected once your spot on the trip has been confirmed.Gear is available for loan through the Worcester Chapter Gear Shed for those who may need it. As an affinity group within AMC that is dedicated to encouraging people in their 20s and 30s to enjoy the outdoors, this is a trip for those in their 20s and 30s.
